page.overview:
Who is El-Naumri?

was a night angel who served Sylandri and became a psychopomp for the souls of elves in Aramán.

In a vision about their death, El-Naumri's body was humanoid in shape until it turned in autumn leaves.

This angel was described as a "warrior of autumn leaves" with broad wings, a sensitive figure who felt for the mortal children of the goddess of life.

In one version of the story of the origin of the Stone of Nightsong, it was said to have been carved from the rib of El-Naumri, a celestial who died of grief in the moment of the first elf's passing. When he did so, Tezumriel, another angel of Sylandri, carved the Stone from his bones. El-Naumri would not permit the soul of the young elf who died to walk into the shadow alone, and therefore became the first angel of death of the elven people, facilitating their passing into the realms beyond life.
